2226-2397-4443.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
2226-2397-4443.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Panharmonicon.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Riftwing Cloudskate by paying its mana cost.
When Riftwing Cloudskate enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

2267-3240-6462-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Tormod triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2023-4518-6723-6968.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2738-4871-5686-6255.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Zahur, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Zahur trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 1.
Repeat.

as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-745-1619-4089.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-745-1619-4089.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Glasspool Mimic and Mirrorhall Mimic each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Glasspool Mimic trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Mirrorhall Mimic trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-745-1619-4089.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

Armor Wars' second chapter ability has resolved this turn.
3532-5078-7693-7750.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Medusa triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3899-4241-4552-7704.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Karn
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

997-4350-6972.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Butcher Ghoul
When Butcher Ghoul dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Butcher Ghoul
When Butcher Ghoul dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Butcher Ghoul enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. Its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.
997-4350-6972.notes: If Butcher Ghoul starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

5412-5795-6871-6879.description:

When Barkform Harvester enters, Haru triggers, targeting Barkform Harvester as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing Barkform Harvester.
When Barkform Harvester dies, Haru triggers, returning Barkform Harvester from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Barkform Harvester enters, Haru triggers, targeting Barkform Harvester as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Coastal Hornclaw ability.
Repeat from step 3.

4050-4871-6476-6991.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three opponents that each have a creature card that will enter the battlefield with greater than 0 toughness in their graveyard.
4050-4871-6476-6991.description:
Cast Afterlife from the Loam by paying at most {5}{B}{B}{B}, returning Donnie & April and at least three other creatures from graveyards to the battlefield under your control.
When Donnie & April enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Afterlife from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing four of the creatures returned in step 1, including Donnie & April, adding {4}.
When the creatures die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers four times, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate the four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1651-2638-4426-5334-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1651-2638-4426-5334-6756.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1651-2638-4426-5334-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Tireless Tracker triggers twice due to Roaming Throne, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

1399-1606-5929-6984.notablePrerequisites:
Evendo has at least twelve charge counters on it.
You control at least three creatures.
1399-1606-5929-6984.description:
Activate Evendo by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Evendo.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

3769-5256-5571--6.easyPrerequisites: Blim does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
3769-5256-5571--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Gyre Sage by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Scryb Ranger by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Gyre Sage.

Repeat.

2034-4613-4679-4730--128.manaNeeded: {2} plus enough mana to activate the Licid's ability
2034-4613-4679-4730--128.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to activate the Licid's ability.
2034-4613-4679-4730--128.description:
Activate Sparring Mummy using the Licid's ability by paying its activation cost, attaching Sparring Mummy to Yenna and causing Sparring Mummy to become an Aura.
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Sparring Mummy.
When the Sparring Mummy token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Sparring Mummy token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

914-3036-4785.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-3036-4785.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Wizard Mentor by paying {2}{U}.
Activate Wizard Mentor by tapping it, returning it and Dockside Extortionist to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
If opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

500-1270-2523-4365.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Ojer Taq and creating four token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
Put all but one Ojer Taq token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Ratadrabik triggers four times from the nontoken and token Ojer Taqs dying.
Resolve the first trigger, creating 2*(3^X) nonlegendary token copies of Ojer Taq that are 2/2 Zombies, where X is the number of Ojer Taqs you control.
Repeat step 4 for the remaining triggers.
500-1270-2523-4365.notes: Assuming you control no other token doublers, this combo will make a total of 10^(10^695.6224481408007) creature tokens.

1445-4927-5477.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one creature card in your hand.
You have at least one creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4927-5477.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning any other creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token, then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Activate the Plant by tapping it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2438-6431--5.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Celes's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

1432-4613-6210.easyPrerequisites:
Neerdiv has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Neerdiv, Devious Diver does not have summoning sickness.
1432-4613-6210.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature that does not have summoning sickness and that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
1432-4613-6210.description:
Activate a creature using Ioreth of the Healing House's ability by tapping it, untapping Neerdiv.
Activate Neerdiv using Ioreth of the Healing House's ability by tapping it.
Neerdiv triggers, causing a player to mill cards equal to its power.
Resolve the Neerdiv ability from step 2, untapping another creature.
Repeat.

791-3693-5934-6257.notablePrerequisites:
There are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard.
You have max speed.

Walking Ballista has at least two +1/+1 counters on it, or your life total is at least 4.
791-3693-5934-6257.description:
Give Walking Ballista lifelink, if needed.

Activate Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 4 damage to an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls, and causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 2.

3705-4050-4871-5465.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
When Squee dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R}.
Repeat.

413-3388--5.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Moritte of the Frost.
When Moritte of the Frost dies, it triggers its persist ability, returning itself to the battlefield as a copy of the creature with persist with two +1/+1 counters and one -1/-1 counter on it.
Remove one +1/+1 counter and one -1/-1 counter from Moritte of the Frost as a state-based action.
When Moritte of the Frost enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the activated ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

914-5626.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least two energy counters.
Opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments.
You control another nontoken creature with mana value 4 or less.
914-5626.description:
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}, sacrificing a nontoken creature with mana value 4 or less and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{B}{B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying at most {E}{E}{E}{E}, sacrificing Dockside Extortionist and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning a creature with mana value 4 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.
If opponents control five or more artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.
If the creature sacrificed has mana value 3 or less, this combo nets infinite energy counters.

779-833-2546-2713.description:

Resolve the Soul of Windgrace ability, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

2979-3177-4543.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one land card in hand.

Activate Patchwork Crawler using Sakura-Tribe Scout's ability by tapping it, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
If the land is mana-producing and enters the battlefield untapped, you may activate it by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Patchwork Crawler using Trench Behemoth's ability by returning the land from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Patchwork Crawler.
Repeat.

1633-2060-3129-3415-4120.description:
Cast Hanabi Blast by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve Hanabi Blast, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Vigor's first ability, and then returning Hanabi Blast to your hand and discarding a card at random.
Conspiracy Theorist's second ability triggers, allowing you to exile the discarded card from your graveyard if it was a nonland card and cast it from exile this turn.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{R}{R}.
Cast Hanabi Blast either from your hand or from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite colored mana, you may instead target any other creature and/or player with Hanabi Blast.

234-411-3309-4875.description:
Cast Grinning Ignus by paying {2}{R}.
Merrow Reejerey triggers, untapping Twinning Glass.
Activate Grinning Ignus by paying {R} and returning it to your hand from the battlefield, adding {C}{C}{R}.
Activate Twinning Glass by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to cast Grinning Ignus without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

579-2540-5137.notablePrerequisites:
Morphling does not have summoning sickness.
Morphling has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
579-2540-5137.description:
Activate Morphling by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Morphling's first ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

Put Vesuva into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Vesuva and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Scaretiller.
Resolve the Vesuva trigger, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.

Once that opponent draws a card they draw their entire library and take damage equal to the amount of cards drawn.
